name: Metellos
description: Metellos was a planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was connected via a hyperspace route to the distant planet Ilum in the Unknown Regions. The route was mapped by hyperspace surveyors hired by the Jedi Order as Ilum was a world important to the training of a Jedi.
